title: Review of Singapore's Laws to Deter Online Child Pornography
what_it_is: Review of Singapore's Laws to Deter Online Child Pornography

sections.label: Online child pornography law review
sections.summary: The passage states that IMDA can act against child sexual abuse content hosted in Singapore and that a Penal Code review will be publicly consulted later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs whether he can provide an update on the review of Singapore's laws deterring online child pornography and what will be done to restrict, deter and punish access to and the hosting of child pornography websites in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: So, they are required to comply with the Internet Code of Practice and ensure that prohibited material, such as child sexual abuse content, is not hosted on their websites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: If child sexual abuse websites are verified to be hosted in Singapore, the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) can: (a) direct the ICPs to take down the content; (b) issue directions to the Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to block access to the websites; and (c) suspend or cancel the class licences of the ICPs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: I mentioned yesterday that there is a major review of the Penal Code.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We are looking at whether there should be dedicated laws dealing with activities related to child pornography – from the making of pornographic material involving children, to possession and distribution of such material, and also whether such laws should carry higher penalties to send a stronger deterrent message.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Those review proposals will be tabled for public consultation later this year.
